chunks.text: Isla Clarence is an island of Chile's Magallanes region and is recognized by SBAP/SIMBIO as a geoform of the Estrecho de Magallanes Central - Magallanes marine ecosystem (ECOMAR-058).

SBAP/SIMBIO identifies the subcuenca Islas Clarence y adyacentes within the cuenca Islas al Sur Estrecho de Magallanes. This is watershed context and must not be treated as an administrative boundary.
